title: Dual-backend support: Ollama AND llama.cpp simultaneously
objective: Support both Ollama and llama.cpp simultaneously with CLI model switching between any model on either backend. models.txt uses section headers [ollama] and [llamacpp]; scripts/regen-configs generates dual-provider opencode.json; compose.yaml has both ollama and llamacpp services; lab script runs both pull services; OpenCode /model command works across both providers.
